title: console: the "This app can't be opened" screen is a dead end — only Retry, no Back to home, no app bar
body:
Filing gate: **① a user-visible UX defect with a named landing point and a reproduction** (`pm:queue` class).
Reader: the objectui lane owning `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` — the fix PR there.
Dedupe (open AND closed, semantic search on objectstack-ai/objectui): "app can't be opened not found screen no way back home chrome-less" → 2 hits (#12305, #4473); "app not found verdict screen Retry only missing Back to home link" → 0; none covers this item.

reach: measured in the console UX walkthrough — stock showcase with `--seed-admin`, framework objectstack-ai/objectstack@54159fd742e5, console pin objectui@12dc7b47c340 (dist stamp equal to the pin), Chromium at 1440x900; re-checked against objectui main source at df943a2a1af3 when found and ed28057 when split (the cited files are unchanged between the two).
type: Bug

Split out of #13115 (item 1), which folded fifteen independent defects into one card under the per-fire filing quota, which the maintainer has since ruled does not bind a concentrated test run such as a walkthrough. Split by the 18.0 QA wave dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`, on the maintainer's instruction there, verbatim: 「#13115 你可以拆」.

## Where

Open `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.studio` — an app id the server does not return (a stale bookmark, an uninstalled app).

## Actual

A full-screen "This app can't be opened / The server did not return this app for your account." with only a Retry button — no app bar, no Back to home, no link anywhere.

## Expected

The same way out the access-denied screen already offers (its "Back to home" button), on the not_found / unreachable / not-available verdicts too.

## Source

`packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` — the `requestedAppMissing` branch's `verdictScreen` renders Empty + Retry only; `renderAppAccessDenied` has the home button.
